push.title: L 1-4 vs LavaCakesFc | You: 7.4
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.4 against LavaCakesFc. You're trending up like a hot-air balloon at the fair.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against LavaCakesFc. The net said thank you, and so do I.
+ Tackles attempted 5, up from your usual 2. Nobody hands out trophies for that, so here's my handshake.
+ Stayed on and finished the match after BellyTb1 walked off. Little things like that are big things in disguise.
+ 3rd straight match at 80% pass accuracy. That's the reliable kind of good.
+ 1 key pass: +0.2. That's value.

THE BAD
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Best practice: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. Bread and butter.
- Missed tackles 4, up from your usual 1. From the clipboard: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away.
- 0.5 under your norm. Rest up, reset, return.
- Assists 0, down from your usual 1. That's the leak in the boat.
- Their humans averaged 8.3 to our 7.1; we were second best man for man. We'll talk about it as a group, then leave it behind us.

Drill: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound.

Listen here, PhogsToffees: Taking on a challenge is a lot like riding a horse. Comfortable is overrated.

Hard days make strong players. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
buddskees, a 6.7. We'll be curious about it, not cruel about it.

THE GOOD
+ 25 passes. You were the hub, and hubs keep wheels turning.
+ Stayed on and finished the match after BellyTb1 walked off. Keep stacking those bricks.

THE BAD
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Homework: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs. Clean it up and fly.
- No key passes from 25 passes. Low-hanging fruit: Look for the third man: pass to the feet of the player who can find the runner.
- 4 goals conceded: -0.1. Let's polish that.
- Their humans averaged 8.3 to our 7.1; we were second best man for man. That's the bill for the little mistakes, and we all chipped in.
- Pass accuracy: 76%. That's a B. The A-students among midfielders are at 87%+.

THE UGLY
! Their best midfielder posted 9.8 to your 6.7. If the tape had a smell, that part would stink.

Fundamentals drill: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.

Remember, buddskees: If plan A doesn't work, the alphabet has 25 more letters.

I believe in you, period. - Coach Lasso
